description: Canonical network topology for Mimir. Scripts and docs must match this file.

access_model.notes: Clients use Tailscale HTTPS. Server operators use loopback on the host. LAN is dev-only fallback via mimir/scripts/start_lan.sh.

topology.server_role: Mimir runs on Atlas via docker compose (prod-postgres profile: api-pg on host port 8787).
topology.listener_notes: API and MCP share one HTTP listener. MCP is at {endpoint}/mcp; REST API at {endpoint}/api/*.

endpoints.endpoint_notes: Real tailnet host is site-local; set MIMIR_ENDPOINT rather than hardcoding it.

auth.server_storage: Mimir server database (owner API key); not committed to repos
auth.missing_key_behavior: HTTP 401 on /api/* and /mcp; verifier reports auth_failure

repo_roots.indexing_rule: Indexing and code navigation operate only on paths visible inside the Mimir server container mount.
repo_roots.client_path_rule: Client machines do not mount repos into Mimir. They reference repo_name (e.g. agent) for queries against host-indexed repos.

remote_capabilities.notes: Remote PCs are governed consumers of the Atlas Mimir service. Serena runs locally per workspace; Mimir memory/navigation is remote.
